posts.text: Olja skal vel snart over 100, men da skal vel PEN videre ned.. Asia’s Oil-Buying Spree Sends Middle East Crude Prices Soaring Refiners in India and China, the world’s two biggest oil importers, are stepping up spot purchases of Middle Eastern crude and pushing prices higher. Oil processors in both countries are bidding more aggressively for Persian Gulf barrels, competing with buyers in South Korea and Japan for supplies threatened by a flare-up in US-Iran hostilities. Benchmark Dubai futures have climbed to nearly $100 a barrel, the highest since May, while physical premiums for Oman and Murban crude have also surged on concerns over disruptions from Iran and its proxies, such as Yemen’s Houthis.
